inputs.52.text: Modern flat-colour anime illustration in the style of a cute mobile-game mascot key visual: bold, clean dark outlines of even weight, bright flat cel colours filled edge to edge, one simple step of soft lavender shading, crisp edges everywhere. A small, quiet teenage bedroom, seen at seated eye height from the far side of a small study desk, looking across the desk toward the room. A small white study desk runs across the lower part of the picture, its top scattered with loose sheets of paper, a violet pencil cup and a few eraser crumbs. An empty violet chair is tucked behind the desk. On the left, a tall window beside the desk with rain running down the glass and a soft white rainy sky outside, a pale violet curtain tied at its edge. Behind the chair, a smooth off-white wall with a small bookshelf of violet and pastel spines on the right and a small potted green plant. White, violet and pale lavender with small touches of mint green and sunflower yellow. Soft, cool, even rainy daylight from the window on the left, gentle pale shadows.
